scenario: Helios Energy raised capital through a private placement. It conducted no general solicitation or advertising. The offering was sold to 12 accredited investors and 40 non-accredited investors.
policy: A securities offering qualifies for the Regulation D Rule 506(b) exemption only if it involves no general solicitation AND sells to no more than 35 non-accredited investors. If either condition is violated, the offering does not qualify for the 506(b) exemption.
question: Does the offering qualify for the Rule 506(b) exemption?
